Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Persistent Seiton decisions, PvP warnings, and an optional physical-input Purify helper.
Description: A local Crystalline Conflict reaction-cue HUD with an optional Wolves' Den duel test mode. Ninja gets persistent PREP and SHIFT+slot Seiton decisions; every job can see selected PvP warnings. The one-attempt Purify helper supports fresh keys plus an optional held-key trigger and separate toggles for every removable CC type.
